note: Insee's definition, read 2026-10-30: everyone born in metropolitan France or an overseas department (DOM) is entered in the RNIPP and given the NIR; Guadeloupe is an overseas department (the Constitution, arts. 72-3 and 73, as the ids file GP.json cites it; the Conseil constitutionnel's page reset the connection when fetched again today), so its people hold France's number.

sources.title: Insee, Définition: Numéro d'inscription au répertoire (NIR)
sources.said: Toute personne née en France métropolitaine et dans les départements d'outre-mer (DOM) est inscrite au répertoire national d'identification des personnes physiques (RNIPP).
